########################################
#
# Script contains rarefaction analysis to determine the number of
# productive AIRR sequences processed by LongAIRR at different sequencing depths.
# We compare the technical replicated datsets at different quality filter settings
# S1_ONT_Q10, S1_ONT_Q17 and S1_PB_Q17 and split by locus (BCR, TCR)
# Rarefaction curves are split 
#
# Results are shown in LongAIRR Fig. 3b
#
########################################

```{r}
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
# getter function
get_subsamples <- function(which) {
  if (which == "A") return(subsamples_A)
  if (which == "B") return(subsamples_B)
  if (which == "C") return(subsamples_C)
}
```

```{r}
# build counts
# one row per dataset x subsample x receptor
rows <- list()
k <- 1

for (d in seq_len(nrow(datasets))) {

  ds_name <- datasets$dataset[d]
  base_out <- datasets$base_out[d]
  ver <- datasets$version[d]
  subs_tbl <- get_subsamples(datasets$subsample_set[d])

  message("=== Dataset: ", ds_name, " (ver=", ver, ") ===")

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(subs_tbl))) {
    ss <- subs_tbl$subsample[i]
    # paths
    airr_file_bcr <- file.path(base_out, ss,  "airr", airr_filename_bcr)
    airr_file_tcr <- file.path(base_out, ss,  "airr", airr_filename_tcr)

    # BCR (+filter)
    df_bcr <- readr::read_tsv(airr_file_bcr, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE) %>%
                              dplyr::mutate(v_region_sequence = stringr::str_sub(toupper(sequence),
                                            start = as.integer(v_sequence_start),
                                            end = as.integer(v_sequence_end))) %>%
                              filter(!is.na(c_call) & str_sub(c_call, 1, 3) == locus & !grepl("TTTTTTTTTTT", umi) & !grepl("N", junction) & !grepl("N", v_region_sequence))
    
      # consensus == 1 group
      bcr_total <- df_bcr %>%
        filter(consensus_count == 1) %>%
        summarise(n = n_distinct(group), .groups = "drop") %>%
        pull(n)
      # consensus > 1 group
      bcr_cons1 <- df_bcr %>%
        filter(consensus_count > 1) %>%
        summarise(n = n_distinct(group), .groups = "drop") %>%
        pull(n)
    # put it in the list
    rows[[k]] <- tibble(dataset = ds_name, subsample = ss, receptor = "BCR",
                        metric = "cons = 1", unique_molecules = bcr_total); k <- k + 1
    rows[[k]] <- tibble(dataset = ds_name, subsample = ss, receptor = "BCR",
                        metric = "cons > 1", unique_molecules = bcr_cons1); k <- k + 1

    # TCR (+filter)
    df_tcr <- readr::read_tsv(airr_file_tcr, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE) %>%
                              dplyr::mutate(v_region_sequence = stringr::str_sub(toupper(sequence),
                                            start = as.integer(v_sequence_start),
                                            end = as.integer(v_sequence_end))) %>%
                              filter(!is.na(c_call) & str_sub(c_call, 1, 3) == locus & !grepl("TTTTTTTTTTT", umi) & !grepl("N", junction) & !grepl("N", v_region_sequence))
      # consensus == 1 group
      tcr_total <- df_tcr %>%
        filter(consensus_count == 1) %>%
        summarise(n = n_distinct(group), .groups = "drop") %>%
        pull(n)
      # consensus > 1 group
      tcr_cons1 <- df_tcr %>%
        filter(consensus_count > 1) %>%
        summarise(n = n_distinct(group), .groups = "drop") %>%
        pull(n)
    # put in the list
    rows[[k]] <- tibble(dataset = ds_name, subsample = ss, receptor = "TCR",
                        metric = "cons = 1", unique_molecules = tcr_total); k <- k + 1
    rows[[k]] <- tibble(dataset = ds_name, subsample = ss, receptor = "TCR",
                        metric = "cons > 1", unique_molecules = tcr_cons1); k <- k + 1
  }
}

#combine all rows
counts_raw <- bind_rows(rows)
```


```{r}
# add fraction metdata
meta_A <- subsamples_A %>% mutate(subsample_set = "A")
meta_B <- subsamples_B %>% mutate(subsample_set = "B")
meta_C <- subsamples_C %>% mutate(subsample_set = "C")
meta_all <- bind_rows(meta_A, meta_B, meta_C)


counts_df <- counts_raw %>%
  left_join(datasets %>% select(dataset, subsample_set), by = "dataset") %>%
  left_join(meta_all, by = c("subsample", "subsample_set")) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * fraction) %>%
  arrange(receptor, dataset, metric, fraction)

#example check
head(counts_df %>% 
  filter(dataset=="S1_PB_Q17", receptor=="BCR") %>% print(n=Inf))

counts_df2 <- counts_df %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("cons = 1", "cons > 1")))
```

#rarefaction figure
```{r}
sample_cols <- c("S1_PB_Q17"  = "#2f5e8fff", "S1_ONT_Q17" = "#000000ff", "S1_ONT_Q10" = "#d95f02ff", "S1_ONT_reseq_total" = "#1b9e77ff")

counts_df2$dataset <- factor(counts_df$dataset, levels = c("S1_PB_Q17", "S1_ONT_Q17", "S1_ONT_Q10", "S1_ONT_reseq_total"))
counts_df2$metric <- factor(counts_df$metric,levels = c("cons = 1", "cons > 1"))

x_guides <- counts_df2 %>%
  distinct(percent) %>%
  arrange(percent)
```


```{r}
make_p3 <- function(df, rec) {
  ggplot(df %>% filter(receptor == rec), aes(x = percent, y = unique_molecules, color = dataset, linetype = metric, group = interaction(dataset, metric))) +
    geom_vline(data = x_guides, aes(xintercept = percent), inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.9) +
    facet_grid(metric ~ ., scales = "free_y", switch = "y", labeller = labeller(metric = function(x) paste(rec, x))) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20), labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = sample_cols) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("cons = 1" = "solid", "cons > 1" = "twodash")) +
    labs(x = "Raw input reads (%)", y = "Number of unique UMI-SPBC groups", color = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.25),
      panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.45, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.28, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.y = unit(1, "pt"),
      legend.key.spacing.x = unit(4, "pt"),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
}
```

```{r, fig.width=2, fig.height=3}
p3_bcr <- make_p3(counts_df2, "BCR") +
  ggh4x::facetted_pos_scales(y = list(
                  metric == "cons = 1" ~ scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 200000, by = 10000), labels = label_number(big.mark = " ")),
                  metric == "cons > 1" ~ scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 15000, by = 10000), labels = label_number(big.mark = " "))))

p3_bcr
```


```{r, fig.height=3, fig.width=2}
p3_tcr <- make_p3(counts_df2, "TCR") +
  ggh4x::facetted_pos_scales(y = list(
                  metric == "cons = 1" ~ scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 7000, by = 450), labels = label_number(big.mark = " ")),
                  metric == "cons > 1" ~ scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1000, by = 450), labels = label_number(big.mark = " "))))

p3_tcr <- p3_tcr +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())
```

```{r, fig.width=4.5, fig.height=3}
p3_b_test <- (p3_bcr | p3_tcr) + plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1,1.1)) &
  # theme(
  #   legend.position = "bottom",
  #   legend.box = "horizontal",
  #   legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
  #   legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
  #   plot.margin = margin(l=2, 0, 0, 0))
  guides(linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 1, order = 1), color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, order = 2)) &
  theme(
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.direction = "horizontal",
  legend.box = "vertical",
  legend.box.just = "center",
  legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(0, "pt"),
  legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
  legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
  plot.margin = margin(l = 2, 0, 0, 0))

p3_b <- p3_b_test + patchwork::plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)))
p3_b
```
